The Bajaj Pulsar 150 has been around for 25 years. But in a world where motorcycles keep evolving, can the OG still hold its own?
The new Pulsar 150 gets an entirely new engine, a revised chassis, new suspension, ride modes and a 5-inch TFT display. It also sheds 9 kg compared to its predecessor. On paper, that's a pretty significant update. But how much of the old Pulsar's character survives?
